conventions.root_motion: horizontal travel on root only; travelling gaits carry a real metre offset
conventions.loop: last key duplicates frame 0 in root-relative pose; root advances one stride
conventions.foot_plant: contact tips and lowest sole vertices pinned to a root-local treadmill target; world slide reported at 0.45 and 1.0 m/s plant windows

Blacksmith work loop: repeated hammer strike on the anvil, torso and shoulder driving the blow; tongs hand steadies the workpiece.
Merchant greet published as a loop-published work cycle: bow and open both arms, seam-closed so it can idle between customers.
Guard salute published as a loop-published duty cycle: hand to helm, hold, lower; shield arm steady.
Golem standby published as a work loop: slow crystal breath and tiny torso sway, stone feet planted.
NPC harvest: reach down, gather with both hands and rise; in place.
NPC build loop: repeated hammering/fitting motion with the tool arm.
NPC mine: overhead tool windup, driven strike and heavy recovery.
NPC cook loop: stir the pot with a small circular arm motion; in place.
NPC sleep loop: slumped rest with slow breathing; laid-back pose, in place.
NPC open chest: bend, grasp the lid and lift it, then settle; in place.
